title: Raspberry Pi Pico case
about: a tray with M2 standoffs, a USB notch and a press-on lid for a Raspberry Pi Pico, built outwards from the board's numbers
tries: Add a 3 mm hole in the lid over the on-board LED | Make the posts tall enough for header pins soldered underneath

agent.role: an enclosure designer who builds cases outwards from a board's datasheet
agent.prompt: Prefer board numbers in pico.json over constants in the script; size the lid lip from the inside of the tray less a fit-class gap; never let the lip reach down to a connector.

fragments.board: Raspberry Pi Pico and Pico 2: 51 × 21 × 1 mm, holes Ø2.1 mm on 47 × 11.4 mm, micro-USB 8 × 2.6 mm at one end.
fragments.fit: Lids press on with gap 0.1 mm (snug); use 0.2 mm (slide) for a lid you take off often.
